run.command: uv run python -m exsolver.experiments.e1_kuhn eval --out runs/e1 --data data/e1a --device auto --no-progress

training.spec_deviation: Training defaults are batch 32 x 12000 steps instead of the spec's 64 x 20000: measured MPS throughput for the 4 x 128 model at L = 640 is ~100-135 session-passes/s, so the spec budget would take several hours; --batch/--steps override the defaults.
